reviews.code_status: No paper-specific public method source verified in fixed v1 and reviewed sources; cited dependencies are not a release.
reviews.scope: The local slice implements medians of supplied ten-feature rows, fixed-calibration projection and an optional numerically stable logistic readout. It does not extract ASTs/dependency graphs, run an Injector/Oracle/solver, fit calibration or train models. Complete means, scales, intercept and reference bounds are not released as a loadable artifact, so Calibration is an explicit required input. Diagnostics use synthetic calibration and do not reproduce the author's eight-benchmark CCI. Patch features belong to curation/evaluation; hidden repair patches or their difficulty labels must not be exposed to the evaluated agent.
reviews.cost_basis: The full study covers222 repositories,6,600+ variants, repeated ML pipelines, frontier-model Oracle/judges and a five-stage Qwen3.5-9B LoRA SFT/GRPO pipeline, with evaluation episodes allowed up to eight hours. This clearly exceeds a cheap single-A100/A30 or Mac run. No datasets/weights or trial runs are started; only tiny arithmetic controls execute.

reviews.code_status: No paper-specific public method source verified in fixed v1 and reviewed sources; cited dependencies are not a release.
reviews.scope: The local kernel executes public-state keys, separate pending decisions and actual executions, third-proposal interception, exact two-action takeovers and benchmark-specific counters. It takes declared public fields, not gold/reward/success labels. A trusted external ALFWorld adapter supplies new_information; semantic fact verification is not implemented. There is no Jev/LLM backend, benchmark environment or API request. Controlled traces validate routing rules, not task success.
reviews.cost_basis: The full matrix spans334 tasks, seven frontier LLMs, full/routed comparisons, six additional decision models and ablations with real Jev/API services and long environment rollouts. One GPU cannot substitute those services or charges. Full experiments are not run; only seconds-scale CPU routing controls execute without models or paid APIs.

reviews.scope: The local substrate implements append-only records, explicit-summary compaction, post-compaction grep admission, regex/pagination/context/original line numbers, recursive-output exclusion and character limits. Regexes run in a separate worker with a hard timeout over supplied text, never paths. Summaries are explicit caller inputs. There is no LLM summarizer, GRPO, question answering or real-history integration. Tests use synthetic public observations and never read local Codex sessions; string retrieval is not agent capability.
reviews.cost_basis: Each paper run uses24 H100s (8 trainer,16 rollout) plus a shared three-GPU dense retriever; total training is about6,000 H100-hours over4,000 episodes and a9B model. Full training/evaluation is not reproduced on the single-GPU budget; no model or14.9M-document corpus is downloaded. Only seconds-scale CPU log/retrieval controls run.
